نبتدع (form VIII)
# نَبْتَدِعُ (nabtadiʕu) /nab.ta.di.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# نُبْتَدَعُ (nubtadaʕu) /nub.ta.da.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# نَبْتَدِعَ (nabtadiʕa) /nab.ta.di.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# نُبْتَدَعَ (nubtadaʕa) /nub.ta.da.ʕa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
